name: Address portfolio inspection
what_it_can_answer: Inspect an Ethereum address portfolio including token holdings, total USD value, transactions, and historical portfolio context described by the sources.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not prove ownership, identity, current price accuracy, tax treatment, or current feature availability.
unique_value: Combines address-level token balances and USD portfolio context in an explorer workflow.

name: Token and address search
what_it_can_answer: Search for Ethereum tokens, addresses, public tags, and user-tagged records using the documented Ethplorer search experience.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not prove token safety, legitimacy, completeness, or the current ranking algorithm.
unique_value: One search surface spans tokens, addresses, and known or private tags.

name: Token and address charts
what_it_can_answer: Review documented token and address charts including historical USD balances, candles, period highs and lows, moving averages, transfers, volume, and market capitalization.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not predict prices, guarantee metric coverage, or prove current chart availability and accuracy.
unique_value: Places market and address-history views in the same mobile-capable explorer workflow.

name: Token activity and holder analytics
what_it_can_answer: Inspect documented token transfer activity, holder counts or distribution, volume, and public entity-address context for research.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not establish project legitimacy, liquidity, current adoption, or a general investment or risk score.
unique_value: Connects token market metrics with address and holder evidence.

name: Address and transaction tags and notes
what_it_can_answer: Organize documented address and transaction records with user tags and notes and reuse them in search and review workflows.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not prove identity, accounting completeness, data permanence, or comprehensive scam detection.
unique_value: Adds user-controlled context to public on-chain records.

name: Transaction and annotation export
what_it_can_answer: Export documented address transaction history and tags or notes to CSV or JSON and import supported annotation data.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not guarantee current formats, accounting correctness, tax compliance, or complete data for every workflow.
unique_value: Makes explorer records portable for manual accounting and analysis.

name: Watching Service
what_it_can_answer: Monitor selected Ethereum addresses or token contracts and receive documented transaction notifications with incoming or outgoing filtering.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not guarantee present availability, delivery time, event coverage, theft prevention, or free limits.
unique_value: Turns address activity into user notifications and combines with tags and filters.

name: API Panel
what_it_can_answer: Manage documented Ethplorer API keys and review usage charts, limits, and recent requests in an account panel.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not establish current endpoints, quotas, pricing, authentication, or service-level guarantees.
unique_value: Self-service key management and request diagnostics are presented together.

name: Bulk API Monitor
what_it_can_answer: Track operations for configured address or token-contract pools through the documented Bulk API Monitor workflow.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not prove current capacity, real-time latency, endpoint contract, pricing, or unlimited and million-address claims.
unique_value: Pool-based retrieval is documented as reducing per-address polling overhead for large monitoring workloads.

name: Aggregated Ethereum Rich List
what_it_can_answer: Rank Ethereum addresses by documented totalBalanceUsd across ETH, ERC-20 tokens, and stablecoins under stated exclusions and filters.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not make article snapshot values current or prove complete entity attribution, liquidity, reproducibility, or present ranking behavior.
unique_value: Shows address economic weight beyond an ETH-only balance ranking.

name: Balance composition and PPI analysis
what_it_can_answer: Analyse documented address or project balance composition and use Printing-Press Index to describe the share of own-token value in token holdings.
what_it_cannot_prove: Does not provide a current PPI, generic risk score, AML conclusion, insolvency prediction, or timeless threshold; current numbers require dated dynamic evidence.
unique_value: Separates externally sourced holdings from self-issued token exposure within aggregated address analysis.
